name: SportRack 4 Bike Hitch Rack
description_full: This hitch rack holds 4 bikes and is super sturdy. It has a 2 inch receiver for your vehicle. Max weight 180lbs.

name: Evenflo Pivot Xplore Stroller Wagon
description: Converts between stroller and wagon, fits 2 kids.
description_full: Evenflo Pivot Xplore All-Terrain Stroller Wagon — flips between push (stroller) and pull (wagon) mode with a three-position telescoping handle. Fits up to 2 children from 6 months to 5 years (55 lb per seat, 110 lb total). Features all-terrain wheels for pavement, sand, and trails, a UPF 50+ canopy, 3-point safety harnesses, flip-flop-friendly brakes, and a compact fold for storage.

name: SportRack Bike Roof Rack
description: Roof-mount bike carrier, holds bike upright without removing the front wheel.
description_full: SportRack Upshift Plus (model SR4885) roof-mount bike carrier — holds 1 bike upright without removing the front wheel. Self-adjusting padded jaws clamp the downtube, and large wheel trays with ratcheting straps hold the wheels in place. Fits bike frames up to 3 3/8" diameter and tires up to 2.6" wide; mounts to square, round, and most factory crossbars up to 3.5" (max 45 lb bike capacity). Includes a lock to secure the bike to the rack.
